draft.coverLetter:
Dear Lonza Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Global Head of CGT Operations Strategy & PMO position. My career has been spent where cell-based therapeutics move from the lab into GMP manufacturing, and I recently completed my MBA at Rice University to take on the strategy and portfolio side of that work.

As the first employee at PranaX, I led the end-to-end build-out and operation of an ISO-certified cleanroom for GMP exosome manufacturing. I ran technology transfer, process development and scale-up while leading the systems around them, from equipment procurement and qualification oversight to SOPs, batch-record development, QC, and regulatory alignment. Building that from nothing taught me how operational decisions trade off against timelines, budget and compliance, which is the daily work of a CGT PMO.

At MD Anderson, I now lead development of operational infrastructure for the CPRIT Texas EVCore, managing custom client projects from sample intake through final reporting. Earlier, as a research scientist in the Kalluri Laboratory, I worked on engineered extracellular vesicles, cancer immunotherapy and GLP-ready MSC-derived EVs, contributing to six peer-reviewed publications including Cancer Cell and Nature Communications.

Lonza's cell and gene therapy business needs operations strategy that is grounded in how manufacturing actually runs. I can bring hands-on GMP credibility with site teams, and the business training to build the governance, metrics and portfolio views that leadership relies on. I would welcome a conversation about the scope of this role and how I could contribute from Houston.

Sincerely,
Arya Arian
